abort.single_instance_allowed: Solar view is already set up.

user.title: Solar view
user.description: Where the panels are, and what can hold their production back. Production and export come from the Energy settings.

data_description.export_limit_kw: 0 when nothing may go to the grid, empty when there is no limit.

init.title: Solar view settings
init.description: Pick a section. Each one saves when you press Submit. Settings also in solar_view.yaml are taken from the file.

menu_options.plant: Plant: battery, grid and what it cost

data.pun_estimate: Estimate months without a bill from the PUN Index GME (Italy)

data_description.weather_model: An Open-Meteo model name. ecmwf_aifs025_single covers 16 days and fills the days a shorter model lacks.
data_description.pun_estimate: Needs at least one bill stored with set_month_prices. Calls GME once a day.

plant.title: Plant
plant.description: Leave a field empty to leave it unset. A setting in solar_view.yaml overrides it.

data.saved_before: Saved before Home Assistant recorded it

data_description.battery_kwh: The whole battery, not only the part above the floor. Default: the size in the Energy settings.
data_description.battery_floor: Percent where the inverter stops discharging. Default 20.
data_description.battery_max_charge_kw: Spare sun beyond it goes to the grid in the forecast. Empty: no limit.
data_description.battery_max_discharge_kw: Use beyond it comes from the grid in the forecast. Empty: no limit.
data_description.battery_install_date: Written YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2025-03-15. Set it again when you replace the battery. Default: the system's date.
data_description.standby_w: Left out of the savings the forecast expects. Default: worked out from the house's energy sensor, else 0.
data_description.grid_max_kw: The most the meter gives before it trips (a 3 kW contract in Italy holds 3.3). Empty: no check.
data_description.export_limit_kw: 0 when nothing may go to the grid, empty when there is no limit.
data_description.system_cost: In your currency. Turns on the Payback card.
data_description.install_date: Written YYYY-MM-DD. Payback counts from its month. Default: the first month on record.
data_description.saved_before: In your currency. Added to Payback.

predictions.title: Predictions
predictions.description: How far the page predicts. Empty fields are automatic.

data_description.level: Empty: automatic. Without its data a level steps down to the next one that has it.
data_description.usual_days: How many past days make the usual day, from 3 to 60. Default 14.

machines.title: Machines
machines.description: The machines the washer line says when to start. Not used at the levels none and weather.

data_description.battery_margin: Percent kept above the battery floor when a start is called free. Default 10.
data_description.quiet_hours: No start is suggested in these hours, for example 0-7 or 23:30-6:30. Default 0-7.
data_description.machines: Pick the machines you have. You give each one's figures next.

prices.title: Prices
prices.description: The bill's fixed part. The bands and prices stay in solar_view.yaml (tariff).

data_description.bill_fixed: A meter fee, say, added to every month's cost on Money. In your currency per month. Empty: none.

sensors.title: Optional sensors
sensors.description: Not in the Energy settings. Leave empty to skip. The other sensors stay in solar_view.yaml (sensors).

data_description.load_power: House use, live. Without it, house use is what flows in minus what flows out.
data_description.battery_health: The battery's state of health, where the inverter reports it. It decides the wear warning alone.

machine_washer.title: Washer
machine_washer.description: Leave a field empty to let the page assume a usual run of 1 kWh over 2 hours.

data_description.kwh: Used when there is no sensor, or the sensor has no runs yet.
data_description.sensor: Its runs replace the figures above.

machine_dryer.title: Dryer
machine_dryer.description: Leave a field empty to let the page assume a usual run of 1 kWh over 2 hours.

data_description.kwh: Used when there is no sensor, or the sensor has no runs yet.
data_description.sensor: Its runs replace the figures above.

machine_dishwasher.title: Dishwasher
machine_dishwasher.description: Leave a field empty to let the page assume a usual run of 1 kWh over 2 hours.

data_description.kwh: Used when there is no sensor, or the sensor has no runs yet.
data_description.sensor: Its runs replace the figures above.

error.bad_model: Open-Meteo does not know this model. Check its spelling against Open-Meteo's model list.
error.bad_number: This is not a number in the allowed range.
error.bad_date: Write a real day as YYYY-MM-DD, for example 2025-03-15.

no_weather.title: Solar view: no new weather since {since}
no_weather.description: Open-Meteo has not answered for 12 hours, so the sun forecast is paused. It starts again by itself once Open-Meteo answers.

not_picked.title: Solar view: pick it as the solar forecast
not_picked.description: In Settings > Dashboards > Energy, set the solar panels' forecast to Solar view alone. Another forecast beside it counts the sun twice; without it, the Energy dashboard and the Solar view page read the other forecast.

set_month_prices.name: Set month prices
set_month_prices.description: Stores a finished month's bill prices, so Solar view counts that month at them. Prices are all-in per kWh, excise and VAT included. Give the month alone to remove it.

f1.name: F1 price
f1.description: All-in price per kWh in band F1, or the one price of a single-price contract.

f2.name: F2 price
f2.description: All-in price per kWh in band F2, with F1 and F3.

f3.name: F3 price
f3.description: All-in price per kWh in band F3, with F1 and F2.

f23.name: F23 price
f23.description: All-in price per kWh in band F23, with F1, for a two-band contract.

fixed.name: Fixed part
fixed.description: The month's fixed part, VAT included. Below 0 when a bonus outweighs it.
